executable_remaining.title: Pre-Production Demand Validation
executable_remaining.note:
commerce/preproduction.py prepares a concept post and refuses the ways it can go wrong, because the value and the hazard are the same act: a picture of a thing that does not exist, posted where people buy things, is a pre-order somebody will try to place. A post must say it is a concept in the words a scroller reads rather than in a hashtag at the end, and it is checked as meaning rather than as one blessed sentence, since a rule satisfied by an exact string is a rule somebody routes around by writing a different one. Every phrase that promises a purchase is refused -- shop now, get yours, link in bio, pre-order, available now -- and so is a price, because a number with a currency in front of it is an offer and is the most quietly damaging of them. A concept shown with somebody else's photograph is refused at this door as at every other. The prohibition the owner's directive states outright is structural rather than promised: there is no code path in this module that can author an engagement number, interest comes from a named platform or it is reported unmeasured, and a test asserts the absence by reading the source, because 'we would never' is not a control and the whole category does this. The module's own generated copy passes its own gate, which matters -- a module whose output its gate would refuse is one whose gate gets quietly loosened. Remaining and parked on owned_surfaces: posting needs a site or a Pinterest account nobody has created, so nothing is published; the refusals run anyway, which means they are tested before the day they matter. /api/preproduction.

executable_remaining.title: Proof Stack
executable_remaining.note: quality/proof.py is the ladder the requirement names -- deterministic validation, independent reverse compilation, a physical tester's example, a real customer project, a repeat purchase -- with each rung a query against rows rather than a field anybody can set. Three things make 'marketing must distinguish proof levels honestly' mechanical rather than aspirational. The claim level is the highest *contiguous* rung: a customer photograph arriving before any tester made the thing is real and licenses nothing new, and reporting the highest rung reached in isolation is how a listing ends up claiming a test nobody ran, so the leapfrogged rung is reported rather than averaged away. Language is checked against the level rather than against intention -- check_claim is wired into the policy gate and into certify(), and it is deliberately separate from the existing unsupported-claim patterns, which refuse sentences that are never sayable: 'maker tested' is true the day a tester finishes one and false the day before, and no fixed list tells those apart. And a completed sample that *failed* is evidence and not a proof point, because rung three says the thing came out and a sample that disagreed with the pattern is the most valuable result a sample can produce and the opposite of a proof point. Every rung states what it does not prove as well as what it does, because a ladder that only says what each rung establishes invites the reader to round it up. certify() computes the proof position from its own stages rather than looking it up, which is not circular -- it is the same evidence, and a lookup would read a certificate that call has not issued yet. The permission half is enforced at provenance: tester and customer are permitted asset sources and either without a recorded consent_ref is ASSET_CONSENT_MISSING. A reference rather than a boolean, because somebody has to be able to go and look, and absent consent is not implied consent. Remaining and parked on the customers gate: rungs four and five read False until orders exist, and the key is present rather than absent because a missing key and an unreached rung look identical to a caller and mean completely different things.

executable_remaining.title: Creator and Tester Distribution
executable_remaining.note: growth/creators.py is the roster, and most of it is what cannot be expressed rather than what is computed. A collaboration buys work -- a tested sample, a finished photograph, a colour variation, a crochet-along, a post, a tutorial segment -- and the deliverable vocabulary is closed and contains no opinion, so 'never require or purchase dishonest reviews' is unrepresentable rather than discouraged; a review somebody writes afterwards is theirs and nothing here asked for it. An arrangement conditioned on sentiment is refused even when the deliverable is honest, including the one nobody writes down ('we will send the next one if it goes well'). A stated follower count stays a claim with its source, there is no reach projection anywhere in the module and a test reads the source to assert the absence, because fabricated engagement arrives as a spreadsheet more often than as a lie. An engagement rate and the day it was observed travel together or neither is recorded. Permission is scoped: a photograph licensed for the creator's own channel is not licensed for our listing, an expired permission is refused like an absent one, and a permission with no reference is an assertion. Outreach is a commercial electronic message, so it travels on CASL's conspicuously-published-address basis with both of its conditions checked here (published without refusing unsolicited messages, and relevant to that business capacity) while the message requirements are delegated to growth/owned.py rather than restated. The shortlist is ordered by delivered work rather than audience, because the largest following on a roster has delivered nothing until it has, and the reliability threshold is the tester roster's own constant. Its own test caught a real defect: the disclosure check matched 'ad' inside 'made' and passed 'made with a lovely pattern' as a disclosed partnership -- a substring check that approved the exact copy it existed to catch. Tables: creator_profiles and collaborations, whose outcome columns are nullable because an unmeasured result is not a zero. /api/creators. Remaining and parked on rendered_pages: the roster is empty, and populating it means finding and verifying real people from their public pages. An empty roster is reported as an empty roster and never as a network whose reliability is zero. Re-parked from browser_vision on 2026-09-20 when that gate was split; this is the rendered-page half of it, not the photograph half. Re-parked 2026-09-26 (Build 2 closeout): the roster needs real people to join it, not a browser to read a page; rendered_pages was the wrong gate and would have released this into the ready queue the day a page fetch worked, with nobody on the roster.

executable_remaining.title: Free-to-Paid Acquisition Engine
executable_remaining.note:
growth/free_to_paid.py holds the condition that makes free work pay rather than merely cost: every asset names the premium product it leads to and the reason somebody who just used it would want that next, and an asset without both is a giveaway with a marketing story attached -- pleasant to make, which is why a shop ends up with dozens and cannot say what any of them did. 'It leads to the collection' is refused as a hope rather than a job. The expensive refusal is the second: a free mini pattern for an object this company sells does not lead to it, it replaces it, and that failure is indistinguishable from success from the inside because the downloads and saves go up while conversion falls -- so the check is against the catalogue's own slugs rather than against a judgement about how much was given away. The ladder is the requirement's own -- visitor, consented email, first purchase, repeat purchase, collection purchase -- and a rung nobody reached has no conversion rather than a bad one, because 0% from an upstream of zero makes an untried funnel look like a failed one, which is how something nobody tried gets abandoned as something that did not work. A rung larger than the one above it is refused as a counting fault rather than reported as a remarkable funnel. An email is a rung only once it is consented: the count comes from the CASL consent records through growth/owned.py, since an address captured without a basis is not a step toward a purchase but a liability with a growth metric attached. /api/free-to-paid. Remaining and parked: no free work has been made and nothing is published, because publishing to an owned surface needs a site and a Pinterest account nobody has granted; the plan reports an empty funnel as empty rather than as failing.

executable_remaining.title: Conversion Benchmark Engine
executable_remaining.note: commerce/benchmarks.py makes a baseline belong to a cell -- category, traffic source, price band and the maturity of the shop when it was measured -- because each of those four moves a funnel on its own. compare() returns the refusal and the axes that differ rather than a caveat, since the failure the requirement names is somebody reading two correct numbers side by side: a CA$6 ornament is an impulse at a price nobody thinks about and a CA$15 blanket is a project somebody decides to start, and the shop-wide average sits between two truths and describes neither -- overall() is reported because somebody will ask and is labelled as not comparable to any cell. A thin cell answers, which makes it more dangerous than an empty one, so below three listings or five hundred impressions the number is not produced at all rather than produced with a caveat nobody re-reads. Every metric states what it needs, and an unmeasured one is absent rather than zero: a refund rate of zero on a shop with no orders is not good performance, and a refund rate computed from three orders reads as 33% and is a rumour, which is distinguished from absence by its own message. Price bands come from what the observed market charges rather than from round numbers, so the boundary falls inside the CA$4-12 cluster; maturity is two counts rather than a judgement. A cell keyed on a typo is refused, because it would fail by looking empty. The vocabularies are now shared: #16's experiment memory keys its context on these price bands and this maturity scale, since a memory keyed on 'under_10' against a benchmark saying '6_to_10' matches nothing and lets every closed question quietly reopen. /api/benchmarks. executable_remaining.title: Listing Experiment Discipline
executable_remaining.note: commerce/listing_tests.py adds the four things a listing test needs on top of the pre-registration discipline growth/experiments.py already holds -- a pre-period, exposure, confounders and one primary variable at a time -- and imports the plan and its verdict rather than restating them. Exposure is the one that matters, and it is this build's recurring defect in a new costume: a listing nobody saw did not fail, it was not tested, and to anything reading the outcome column the two are the same row. The consequence is worse than a wrong verdict, because an unexposed test would write a disproof into the memory and block an idea nobody ever tried -- so an unreadable test writes nothing, durably or otherwise. A multi-variable test is allowed, because a listing does sometimes get rebuilt and 'where practical' is otherwise an invitation never to do it; it simply cannot attribute the outcome to any one variable, and it is remembered as a bundle so it never blocks a clean test of one of them later. A confounder is recorded during the window rather than remembered afterwards, and a confounded window is about something else. Only a causal design may close a question: a disproof is the one verdict that stops future work, so a pre/post disproof is kept as an observation, while a supported result that closes nothing is kept as it is. The memory is a table rather than a list, because 'we tried that last year' is exactly the knowledge a restart loses; a disproof applies to the context that produced it (pod, price band, season, shop maturity) and nowhere else, and it reopens when the caller names which part of the context changed -- a memory that never forgets is a way to stop learning, which is the same failure as no memory arriving from the other side. 'Things feel different now' is refused, because it reopens every question ever closed. /api/listing-tests. Remaining and parked: running one needs a live listing and its impressions, so nothing has been established yet and an empty memory says so rather than reporting that nothing is known.

executable_remaining.title: Promotional Science
executable_remaining.note:
commerce/promotion.py holds the three things the requirement asks for. A promotion must end and the end must be a date: past 45 days the discounted price is the ordinary price and the struck-through one is decoration, which is the claim consumer law requires a seller to substantiate, and pricing.check_no_fake_discount already refused the other half -- a was-price this shop never charged. A reduction past 40% is a repricing rather than a promotion. Incrementality is refused without a full-price control, because the discounted arm's conversion rate on its own is a fact about people who were shown a discount, and repeating the promotion on it is exactly how a catalogue learns it cannot sell without one. All three numbers the requirement names are reported -- conversion, AOV and contribution -- and contribution is the one a revenue chart cannot show. Two arithmetic corrections are held as tests. The first version compared the gross full price against the net promo price, which manufactures a contribution loss out of the fee schedule and looks exactly like the divergence this module exists to warn about; it compares net against net now. And the module would otherwise have warned about a danger this business cannot currently have: for a digital pattern the marginal cost of a sale is nearly zero, so revenue and contribution largely move together and both say a discount pays whenever units rise enough to cover the cut. They come apart once a real per-order cost exists -- the flat component of the platform fee, and the cost to create the pattern amortised over the units it sells -- so the module says when the two numbers are telling you the same thing rather than manufacturing alarm. Catalogue dependence is counted from listing rows. Remaining and data-gated: whether anything still sells at full price needs orders, and is reported unmeasurable with the reason, because a catalogue with no sales has no full-price sales either and that is a different finding from one that has stopped having them. /api/promotion.

executable_remaining.title: Owned-Audience Compounding
executable_remaining.note: growth/owned.py turns #20's email clause from a comment into a control. growth/content.py already carried the right sentence -- express consent required before this is ever sent -- in a detail dictionary, and a comment does not stop a send. CASL governs every commercial electronic message this company will ever send, so the rules are code that refuses: a consent has a named basis, a date and a recorded source, and one with no source cannot be checked by anybody later, which is the only thing that makes it a record rather than an assertion. Express consent lasts until it is withdrawn and withdrawal is final. Implied consent expires on its own -- two years from a purchase, six months from an enquiry -- and that is the part that catches careful senders out, because nothing about an address changes on the day it runs out and a list that is not checking simply carries on. Identification and an unsubscribe are conditions of sending rather than good manners, so a message missing either is refused before it reaches an inbox, and the unsubscribe has to keep working for 60 days and be actioned within 10 business days. The module says plainly that passing the screen is not clearance, which is the wording culture/rights.py uses for the same reason. counterparts() reports which certified products have an owned channel and which have none, because a report listing what exists is an inventory and the useful half is the work; an empty coverage report is not full coverage. owned_share() feeds the traffic_source axis of the anti-fragility rule (#29). Remaining and data-gated: assisted conversions and the owned share itself need visits, and are reported unmeasurable with the reason rather than as zero, because a company with no traffic has no marketplace dependence either and that is not the finding anybody wants recorded. /api/owned.

executable_remaining.title: Creator Micro-Seeding
executable_remaining.note: growth/creators.py carries #21's discipline. Seeding starts at zero spend, which is not a compromise -- a digital pattern costs nothing to give, so small legitimate collaborations can begin before any budget exists, and anything above zero is consequential spend the module refuses without the owner. A paid or affiliate arrangement must carry its disclosure in the post the audience actually reads, in words a reader would recognise, rather than in a profile or a linked page. may_scale() is the gate before creator spend grows: three completed collaborations because two is a coincidence, and every outcome measured rather than merely not bad -- attributable traffic, conversions, usable proof assets and support impact. The refusal that matters is the quiet one: a null averages as a zero to anything that averages it, so an unmeasured outcome is named and blocks, because a roster scaled on no bad news is a release passed by the absence of a complaint. Remaining and parked on the customers gate: attributable traffic and conversion need a live listing and real orders. The protocol and its refusals run today, so they are tested before the day they matter.

executable_remaining.title: Cost-to-Create and Profitable Throughput
executable_remaining.note:
finance/unit_cost.py reports both of #31's ratios -- validated products per operating dollar and contribution per operating dollar -- and marks artefacts produced by uncosted work as a floor rather than as cheap. The attribution that made those ratios real landed 2026-09-20: registry.record_cost had always accepted a job id and ModelGateway simply never passed one, so every model cost reached the ledger with a null job, unit_costs() could match none of them to the audit row that produced a pattern or a listing, and every artefact reported a floor while the money was real and counted. Correct arithmetic over an empty attribution, which is the same shape as a scorer nobody feeds. An artefact may now be produced by more than one kind of work -- a concept arrives from scoring, from an expedition and from a tournament, and naming one action would quietly cost only the concepts that came the way somebody listed first -- and an artefact whose count lives in the row rather than one-per-row is counted from the row: a discovery run is a single audit entry that produced eighty concepts, and calling it one concept would report a field at eighty times its unit cost, which reads as a reason to stop doing discovery. A job's cost is attributed once, so two artefacts sharing a job cannot each claim the whole of it and push attributed spend above what was spent. The same day found three disagreeing price tables underneath all of it: the cheap tier routed to 'claude-haiku-4-5' while the billing table held only the dated identifier, so every cheap call was priced at zero and a tournament generating eighty concepts recorded CA$0.00 against a CA$25 ceiling cheap work could never reach; and routing restated the deep tier at USD 5/25 per million tokens while the provider billed 15/75, making every estimate in the system a third of the truth -- the first expedition was estimated at CA$0.15 a field and cost CA$1.02. There is one price table now, routing reads it rather than restating it, and an unpriced model is refused at construction instead of billing zero, which is what _cost_for already said and the constructor silently disagreed with. The last model spend reaching the ledger with a null job was the model probe, which now carries the job that ran it -- an unattributed row is indistinguishable from a cost nobody caused. And the requirement asks for agent and API *minutes* as well as dollars: the gateway already measured the latency of every response and simply did not keep it, so the minutes half had no query behind it. It is persisted with the cost now and reported per artefact, because minutes says whether a thing is slow as well as expensive and those are not the same complaint. Hosting stays unattributed on purpose: it is an operating cost no single artefact caused, and spreading it to make the attribution look complete would make every unit cost wrong in the same direction, which is worse than a number saying it does not know. Remaining and parked on the customers gate: contribution per operating dollar is reported and is zero, which is the true state -- optimising it needs revenue, and no credential grants that. /api/finance.

executable_remaining.title: Replace the narrow Christmas Strike Team with a permanent 365-Day
executable_remaining.note:
seasonal/engine.py replaces the strategy with a score. Seven factors multiplied rather than averaged, because they are conjunctive: an occasion with no time remaining scores zero however strong its demand, and an average would let six good factors carry one fatal one, which is the same reason scale.confidence takes a minimum over its rungs. Three horizons, the seasonal universe left open at the end because the requirement's own list ends with 'and other evidence-backed occasions' and an occasion that shows up in the evidence must not need a code change to be worked. The evergreen floor is the inverse of compression's MIN_PRIORITY_SHARE and nothing had it: that stops a seasonal programme decaying, and nothing stopped evergreen being squeezed to zero by an aggressive seasonal allocation, which leaves a shop with nothing to sell in February. The floor is subtracted before anything is granted rather than checked after, because a floor checked after gets rounded through when the arithmetic is tight -- and it did: three equal occasions rounded to 0.8001 against a pool of 0.8, found by the test and fixed by giving the remainder to the largest share. Squads stand down by arithmetic, since nobody stands a team down in a busy week. Construction primitives and commercial lessons cross seasons; designs, motifs, colourways and listing copy do not, and an unclassified thing is refused rather than crossing by default. Breakout mode may move allocation and is structurally unable to reach a quality, policy, release or spend gate, because 'emergency' is the word people use when they want to skip a step. And the constant the merge instruction names is gone: PRIORITY_PROGRAMMES was a dict with one festival in it holding nearly half of engineering capacity permanently, read by five modules, and all five now call compression.priority_shares(), which returns scores when any occasion has them and the owner's named campaign labelled current_campaign_seed when none does. executable_remaining.title: Pinterest Search Factory
executable_remaining.note:
growth/pins.py carries the instruction the requirement states outright -- avoid spammy duplicate pins -- and the mechanism is not about images. Five pins that differ in crop, overlay and filter are one pin posted five times, and they are indistinguishable from five pins to any check that looks at the file. What makes two pins different is what they are about, and there are seven reasons anybody saves one: the finished object, the fabric detail a maker judges by, the work in progress, the object in a room, the gift it makes, the scale against something familiar, and the yarn itself. A set with fewer than three distinct angles is refused, a repeated angle is the same reason to save offered twice, and the four things a pin factory produces when asked for variants -- a different crop, a different overlay, a different filter, a different aspect ratio -- are named as not being pins. Amplifying a winner means another angle: producing the successful pin again with a different overlay is the same spam arriving through the door marked success, and when every angle is used the next thing is supporting content rather than another pin. The schedule comes from seasonal/calendar.py's own milestones -- listing_indexing_date at ninety days and promotional_ramp at sixty -- rather than from dates chosen here, because a second set of seasonal dates is a second answer to when the work is late, and a pin published the week before the occasion is published after the decision. /api/pins. Remaining and parked: a pin here is an angle, a destination and a date rather than a file, because image generation is a capability nobody has granted; there is no shop, site or listing for a pin to land on, so nothing is publishable; and a pin nobody has seen has no clicks to attribute, so creative testing and attribution wait on the same gate.

executable_remaining.title: Google / SEO Topic Cluster Engine
executable_remaining.note:
growth/clusters.py builds the clusters from questions makers demonstrably asked rather than from questions that sound like searches. A keyword list produced by asking a model what crocheters search for is indistinguishable from a good one until a year of writing has been spent on it, and this company already holds a list it has evidence for: the complaint themes counted from observed reviews. A complaint is an informational intent that arrived too late -- 'the stitch counts do not add up', 'I ran out of yarn', 'it did not fit' are the questions somebody would have typed a week earlier -- so every cluster is seeded from a counted theme, and a theme nobody has seen three times is one customer's bad day rather than a cluster, on intel/observe.py's own RECURRING_AT constant. Three refusals follow. A cluster with no paid destination is a blog: the requirement's chain is informational intent -> free content -> product, and the third link is the one that goes missing first because the first two are enjoyable to make, so each cluster names the product and why somebody whose question was just answered would want it -- and the download cluster says outright that it sells least of all, which is better than pretending every article sells something. executable_remaining.title: Seasonal System Acceptance Test
executable_remaining.note:
seasonal/cycle.py runs the whole cycle the requirement names, in its order, and reports each link's evidence rather than a tick: a benchmark signal somebody recorded, the pods that market is made of, an upcoming event with runway, the customer's lead time chained backwards to a launch date, several original responses, one selected and authored as a CIR, the full release chain run, assets, and search coverage. Verified end to end against a seeded benchmark: 90 listings observed, 5 proven-and-unserved arenas, Halloween/hats at 41 days, 6 concepts proposed, one engineered at a gauge derived from its own yarn, and a certificate granted with the reverse compile among its stages. The clause that makes this an acceptance test rather than a checklist is the last one -- show that the scheduler launched early enough for a customer to make it before the event -- so the cycle ends on that arithmetic and the arithmetic is the verdict. Two defects were found by running it. It first reported complete on a launch date twenty days in the past: the backward chain wanted the product live on 31 August, the cycle measured a buyer's finish from that date, found it comfortable and called the window met. A date that has passed cannot be launched on, so it measures from the earliest date that can be and says the preferred window was missed. And it reported complete for a run with no model provider, which had invented nothing, engineered nothing and certified nothing -- a step the run never reached is absent rather than gated, and absent is not passing, so completeness now requires every named link to have been reached. The verdict is the weakest link rather than a count of green steps, because a backward-chained schedule is exactly the structure where an average hides one broken link, and a gate that stopped the run outranks the steps it stopped: those are consequences and the gate is what somebody can act on. Remaining, and no longer capability-blocked for the imagery half: image generation was proven in production on 2026-09-21, so photographic and styled imagery is buildable rather than waiting, and paid media needs ad_authority -- both are named as gated rather than simulated, because a placeholder product photograph would make the cycle green and prove nothing, and is the one thing the asset-truth gate exists to refuse one level down. /api/seasonal/cycle.
